edges.reason: lengthOfAttribute parameterises the modulo range inside randomAttribute.
block.timestamp is consumed as part of the pseudo-random seed, creating timestamp dependency.
msg.sender is mixed into the seed, so the caller can influence the random outcome.
The keccak256 seed computed by the unsafe random operation is returned by randomAttribute.
The weak random result flows into the randomnumber local variable.
Values returned by randomAttribute are stored into attrsIndex fields.
claim invokes randomAttribute for every attribute.
ownerClaim invokes randomAttribute for every attribute.
The tokenId parameter controls the minted token and the attrsIndex entries written.
manaCost participates in the unchecked-style summation used for validation.
hpCost participates in the summation used for validation.
stamina participates in the summation used for validation.
coolDown participates in the summation used for validation.
The attribute sum check gates execution of claim.
addressMinted is keyed by msg.sender to enforce the per-address mint cap.
claim mints via _safeMint, which performs an external onERC721Received callback to the recipient.
ownerClaim mints via _safeMint, which performs an external onERC721Received callback.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner() before ownerClaim executes.
block.timestamp reaches the random draw through randomAttribute, enabling miner-driven attribute selection.
The tokenId parameter selects the attrsIndex record rendered by tokenURI.
tokenURI reads attribute values from attrsIndex to build the metadata.
tokenURI calls getOccupationColors to obtain the attribute colours.
getOccupationColors writes the computed indices into occupationColors.
tokenURI calls makeAttributeParts to build the JSON attribute list.
